thread:
mike: Heads-up team — planning a shepherded wave tonight 23:00 UTC. Pin plan: runtime=1.12.3, router=2.4.0, console=3.1.1 (minor). No API schema bump. Need cross-service coord for canary and rollback rules. @deploy-bot please schedule canary: 00:05 UTC 2% -> 10% -> 50% over ~20m.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary scheduled for 2026-03-21T00:05:00Z. Steps queued: 2% @00:05, 10% @00:10, 50% @00:25. Will emit status messages to #eng-releases.

sarah: Quick Q — are any kernel/quant changes in the runtime variant? want to know risk for p99 regressions.

jin: Runtime lead here — no quantization profile changes for this wave. We keep `use_fp16_kernels=false`. Main risk is cold-start p95 for new instances, we'll warm via prefetch. I'll post healthcheck commands.

nitya: Router note: console header-swap required for the new console minor. Router will hold route flip until canary hits 10%. Also locking EU->APAC steering to avoid cross-region spill.

mike: Release notes draft (please review): https://redwood.internal/release/4957993333 — rollback criteria added: error rate +5pp OR p99 latency > 500ms sustained for 10m => immediate rollback.

sarah: I'll own SLO monitoring and smoke scripts. Running baseline before 22:50 UTC. Assigning @ops-shepherd to take pager if anything noisy.

ops-shepherd: Oncall covered. I'll be oncall in #eng-oncall for the window. Rollback runbook: if trigger hit, call `deploy-bot rollback --wave=4957993333` then run manual pin revert: 
```
runtime pin set v1.12.2
router pin set v2.3.9
console pin set 3.1.0
```
I'll confirm after rollback completes.

jin: Healthcheck snippet for runtime smoke (use same runner as canary):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.redwood/predict 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"input":"warmup"}' 
  | jq '.latency_ms,.status'
```
Check that latency < 200ms and status==200 for 5 warmup calls.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-21T00:05:00Z (2%). Progress updates will be posted.

mike: TL;DR: no schema change, pin runtime/router, staged canary 2/10/50, rollback triggers in relnotes. If no objections by 22:30 UTC we proceed. :thumbsup:
